title: Number of Compatible Sharing Polynomials
statement: Let $F$ be a finite field and let $k>0$ satisfy $k\le |F|$. For a finite set $B$ of nonzero elements of $F$ with $|B|<k$, a secret $s\in F$, and any prescribed values $w(b)\in F$ for $b\in B$, the number of polynomials of the form $s+Xq(X)$ with $\deg q<k-1$ whose evaluations at every $b\in B$ equal $w(b)$ is $|F|^{k-1-|B|}$.
hypotheses_covered: $B$ is a finite set of nonzero field elements
$w$ assigns an element of $F$ to every nonzero field element
